title: Developer key-rotation + live-stream + tool-call microflow mockups and screenshot pack
creator: Ethan Brooks
description: Design a concise set of developer-facing microflows, composable screenshot assets, and annotated callouts for the API/SDK quickstart. Focus areas: (1) API key creation and safe rotation UX (desktop + mobile snippets), (2) streaming response setup with code + console screenshots, (3) tool-calling examples with structured output samples and visual callouts for error handling and retry behavior. Deliver a Figma file with symbols, exportable SVG/PNG assets, and a lightweight PNG pack sized for docs and release notes.
assets: auth-key-rotation-desktop-3step.svg - three-card flow for create/rotate/revoke with tooltips
auth-key-rotation-mobile-tile.png - compact mobile key rotation CTA + modal state
streaming-setup-code-snippet.png - terminal-style code + inline property labels
streaming-console-screenshot.png - Console streaming toggle + token breakdown overlay
toolcall-sequence-diagram.svg - sequence showing client -> runtime -> tool -> runtime responses
toolcall-response-example.json.png - structured JSON output annotated for docs
component-library-tokens.fig - Figma library for colors/spacing matching console
acceptance_criteria: Figma file delivered with named frames and components for each flow
All assets exportable as 1x/2x PNG and optimized SVGs for docs
Annotated screenshots include callouts for security best-practices (never commit keys), streaming timeout hints, and fallback model behavior
PM and Eng sign-off on accuracy of API snippets and console UI representations
A short handoff checklist for Docs with asset filenames and suggested alt-texts
